Platform Overview

The top-level map of the system: what runs, what talks to what, and where each decision is written down. Start here, then dive into a project.

System landscape

Client apps reach everything through a single edge gateway. Behind it sit two domain services — Onboarding and Payments — each owning its data in Postgres. Cross-domain facts travel asynchronously over the event bus; no service reads another's tables.

Ground rules

  • One writer per table. A service's schema is private; integration happens over events.
  • Decisions are written down. Every irreversible choice gets an ADR in its project folder.
  • Docs live next to the code that implements them and are regenerated by agents on change.
